texts: We sell the things that make a house feel lived in.
A small shop for kitchens, doorsteps and quiet corners. Every price is in pounds, and every item is picked by hand.
Made to last, sold at an honest price.
We started Donkey with one rule: only sell things we would keep in our own homes. That means everyday pieces that hold up, from people we know by name.
We look for small makers who care about how a thing wears in, not how fast it sells. When something runs out, we say so; we would rather be honest than busy.
Everything ships from our shop on Mill Lane, packed by the same people who chose it.
Where most of our prices start
From our shop to your door
A few things you will find on the shelf.
Thrown by hand in a soft oatmeal glaze. Holds a generous cup of tea.
Woven in a mill we have worked with for years. Softens with every wash.
A soft honey scent, poured in small batches. Burns for about forty hours.
Come and have a look around.
Shoppers sign up to buy. It is free, and it takes a minute.
Everyday goods and small prices from Donkey.
